examples.text: 赶紧去休息吧。
examples.trans: Hurry and get some rest.

meanings.note: Verb-object phrase gǎn fēijī ('rush to catch a plane').

examples.text: 明天一早还要赶飞机呢，快去休息吧。
examples.trans: You have an early flight to catch tomorrow—go get some rest.

examples.text: 为了赶飞机去外景地，大家天没亮就出发了。
examples.trans: To catch the flight to location, everyone left before dawn.

辜负.gloss: let down, fail to live up to

meanings.en: let down, fail to live up to
meanings.note: Disappointing someone's trust, goodwill, or expectations.

examples.text: 我一定好好干，绝不辜负大家的信任。
examples.trans: I will work hard and never let down everyone's trust.

examples.text: 随便发脾气很容易辜负别人的好心意。
examples.trans: Losing your temper carelessly easily lets down others' goodwill.

meanings.note: Verb qiānjiù ('give in to someone's wishes').

examples.text: 为什么我不管做什么，你都要一味地迁就我？
examples.trans: Why do you endlessly humour me no matter what I do?

examples.text: 在艺术标准上他从不迁就任何敷衍的做法。
examples.trans: On artistic standards he never accommodates sloppy work.

examples.text: 我在飞机上已经看过了，基本能过。
examples.trans: I already read it on the plane; overall it passes.

examples.text: 我在飞机上已经看过了，基本能过。
examples.trans: I already read it on the plane; overall it passes.

examples.text: 感觉非常好，还要谢谢方老师推荐。
examples.trans: It feels great, and I also want to thank Professor Fang for the recommendation.

examples.text: 这是还要。
examples.trans: This is 还要.

examples.text: 这是谁的呀？
examples.trans: Whose is this?

examples.text: 这是谁的呀？
examples.trans: Whose is this?

examples.text: 杏子姐，是我，我要道歉。
examples.trans: Sister Xingzi, it was my fault — I need to apologise.

examples.text: 道歉？道什么歉？
examples.trans: Apologise? Apologise for what?

examples.text: 不要太着急了，招聘竞争都很激烈。
examples.trans: Do not get too anxious; the hiring competition is very fierce.

examples.text: 这是都。
examples.trans: This is 都.

examples.text: 您居然也会忘事？真是难得。
examples.trans: Even you forget things sometimes? How rare!

examples.text: 今天是个难得的好天气。
examples.trans: Today is a rare stretch of lovely weather.

examples.text: 每次靠近他的时候，脚下总是荆棘遍地。
examples.trans: Whenever I step closer to him, thorns line the path.

examples.text: 直播开始前请不要靠近舞台边缘。
examples.trans: Please stay clear of the stage edge before air time.

examples.text: 黑与白有时是完全颠覆的。
examples.trans: Black and white are sometimes completely reversed.

examples.text: 忙完走出大楼时，外面的天已经全黑了。
examples.trans: By the time we walked out of the building, it was pitch dark.
